title: Advanced Features
excerpt: Discover advanced features like scheduled publishing, version history, and webhooks.
content:
HaruCMS includes powerful features for advanced content management:

  • Scheduled Publishing - Schedule posts to go live automatically
  • Version History - Track changes and restore previous versions
  • Webhooks - Integrate with external services
  • Approval Workflow - Review and approve content before publishing

These features help you manage content efficiently at scale.
